5.4 Skeleton Class
The Skeleton class is generated from the
SI
description of the AUTOSAR meta
model.
ara::com
does standardize the interface of the generated Skeleton class.
The toolchain of an AP product vendor will generate a Skeleton implementation class
exactly implementing this interface.
The generated Skeleton class is an abstract class. It cannot be instantiated directly,
because it does not contain implementations of the service methods, which the service
shall provide. Therefore the service implementer has to subclass the skeleton and
provide the service method implementation within the subclass.
